limitations: Mocked protocol execution does not establish rendering, codecs/devices, platform capture behavior, live streaming, or real OBS performance.
A finite watchdog expiration records that no bounded response was observed; it does not prove an indefinite hang.
The disconnect probe closes before applying an idempotent scene setter; it cannot establish behavior after an applied non-idempotent mutation.

tools.name: obs_connect
tools.description: Connect to OBS WebSocket. Must be called before any other tool.

tools.name: obs_get_status
tools.description: Get current OBS connection and streaming status.

tools.name: obs_health_check
tools.description: Comprehensive OBS diagnostics: connection, streaming, recording, scene, version, latency.

tools.name: obs_list_devices
tools.description: List available video and audio devices to prevent device name guessing.

tools.name: obs_get_scene_list
tools.description: List all scenes and the current active program scene.

tools.name: obs_create_scene
tools.description: Create a new empty scene in OBS.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene to create.

tools.name: obs_remove_scene
tools.description: Remove a scene from OBS. Cannot remove the active program scene. Requires confirmed=true.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene to remove.

confirmed.description: Must be true to confirm deletion. Prevents accidental removal.

tools.name: obs_switch_scene
tools.description: Switch the active program scene.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene to switch to.

tools.name: obs_get_stream_settings
tools.description: Get current stream service settings. Never exposes stream key.

tools.name: obs_set_stream_settings
tools.description: Configure stream service. Presets: youtube, twitch, kick. Or provide custom server URL. Stream key from parameter or OBS_STREAM_KEY env var.

service.description: Streaming service preset: 'youtube', 'twitch', 'kick'. Omit for custom RTMP server.

server.description: Custom RTMP/RTMPS server URL. Required if service is not provided. Ignored if a service preset is used.

stream_key.description: Stream key. If omitted, falls back to OBS_STREAM_KEY environment variable.

tools.name: obs_start_stream
tools.description: Start the OBS stream output.

tools.name: obs_stop_stream
tools.description: Stop the OBS stream output. Requires confirmed=true.

confirmed.description: Must be true to stop the stream. Prevents accidental stream stops.

tools.name: obs_add_source
tools.description: Add a new source (input) to a scene. Common source_type values: image_source, color_source_v3, browser_source, ffmpeg_source, text_gdiplus_v3, monitor_capture, window_capture, game_capture, dshow_input.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene to add the source to.

source_name.description: Unique name for the new source.

source_type.description: OBS input kind. Common types: image_source, color_source_v3, browser_source, ffmpeg_source, text_gdiplus_v3, monitor_capture, window_capture, game_capture, dshow_input.

source_settings.description: Optional input-specific settings as key-value pairs. Example for image_source: {"file": "C:/path/to/image.png"}. Example for browser_source: {"url": "https://example.com", "width": 1920, "height": 1080}. Example for color_source_v3: {"color": 4278190335, "width": 1920, "height": 1080}.

enabled.description: Whether the source is visible when added. Defaults to true.

tools.name: obs_remove_source
tools.description: Remove a source from a scene by name.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene containing the source.

source_name.description: Name of the source to remove.

tools.name: obs_get_source_list
tools.description: List all sources (scene items) in a scene with their properties.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene to list sources for.

tools.name: obs_set_source_transform
tools.description: Set transform properties (position, scale, rotation, crop, bounds) on a source in a scene. Only provided keys are updated.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene containing the source.

source_name.description: Name of the source to transform.

transform.description: Transform properties to set. Supported keys: positionX (float), positionY (float), scaleX (float), scaleY (float), rotation (float, degrees), cropTop (int), cropBottom (int), cropLeft (int), cropRight (int), boundsType (string, e.g. 'OBS_BOUNDS_STRETCH'), boundsWidth (float), boundsHeight (float), boundsAlignment (int). Only provided keys are updated; others remain unchanged.

tools.name: obs_set_source_visibility
tools.description: Show or hide a source in a scene.

scene_name.description: Name of the scene containing the source.

source_name.description: Name of the source to show or hide.

visible.description: True to show the source, false to hide it.

tools.name: build_gaming_scene
tools.description: Build a complete gaming scene with Game Capture, Display Capture, Webcam, and Stream Title overlay. Supports overwrite and auto-switch.

scene_name.description: Name for the gaming scene. Defaults to 'Gaming'.

overwrite.description: If true, clear and rebuild the scene if it already exists. If false (default), return DUPLICATE_SCENE error.

switch_to.description: If true (default), switch to the scene after building.

force.description: If true, allow scene rebuild while streaming. Default false.

tools.name: build_starting_soon_scene
tools.description: Build a 'Starting Soon' scene with color background, title text, optional countdown browser source, and optional image overlay. Supports overwrite and auto-switch.

scene_name.description: Name for the scene. Defaults to 'Starting Soon'.

overwrite.description: If true, clear and rebuild the scene if it already exists. If false (default), return DUPLICATE_SCENE error.

switch_to.description: If true (default), switch to the scene after building.

background_color.description: ABGR color integer for the background. Defaults to dark gray.

title_text.description: Text to display. Defaults to 'Starting Soon...'.

countdown_url.description: Optional URL for a browser source countdown widget.

image_path.description: Optional file path for a background/overlay image.

force.description: If true, allow scene rebuild while streaming. Default false.

tools.name: obs_detect_multi_rtmp_plugin
tools.description: Check if the obs-multi-rtmp plugin is installed and its dock is visible in OBS.

tools.name: obs_list_rtmp_targets
tools.description: List all configured RTMP targets from the Multiple Output dock, including active/inactive state.

tools.description: Add a new RTMP streaming target via the plugin UI. Requires name, server URL, and stream key.

name.description: Display name for the RTMP target.

stream_key.description: Stream key for the target. Never stored or logged.

tools.description: Remove an RTMP target. Requires confirmed=true.

target_name.description: Name of the RTMP target to remove.

confirmed.description: Must be true to confirm deletion. Prevents accidental removal.

tools.name: obs_start_rtmp_target
tools.description: Start streaming to a specific RTMP target. Main OBS stream must be running first (shared encoder).

target_name.description: Name of the RTMP target to start.

tools.name: obs_stop_rtmp_target
tools.description: Stop streaming to a specific RTMP target. Requires confirmed=true.

target_name.description: Name of the RTMP target to stop.

confirmed.description: Must be true to stop the target. Prevents accidental stops.

tools.name: obs_start_all_rtmp_targets
tools.description: Start all configured RTMP targets simultaneously.

tools.name: obs_stop_all_rtmp_targets
tools.description: Stop all active RTMP targets. Requires confirmed=true.

tools.name: teleport_configure_host
tools.description: Configure the OBS Teleport output on the host (sender) machine. Opens Tools -> Teleport dialog, sets enabled state, identifier, port, and quality via UI automation.

enabled.description: Whether to enable or disable Teleport output. Defaults to true.

identifier.description: Teleport host identifier that clients connect to. Defaults to 'OBSTeleport'.

port.description: TCP port for Teleport. 0 = auto (default). Range: 0-65535.

quality.description: JPEG quality for Teleport stream. Range: 1-100. Defaults to 90.

scene_name.description: Scene to add the Teleport source to. Created if it doesn't exist.

source_name.description: Name for the Teleport source. Defaults to 'Teleport Feed'.

identifier.description: Teleport host identifier to connect to. Must match the host's identifier.

tools.name: teleport_get_status
tools.description: Check if the OBS Teleport output exists and get its settings. Uses WebSocket — no UI automation required.

tools.name: cluster_status
tools.description: Check reachability of all cluster nodes. Shows online/offline status for each configured node.

tools.name: cluster_nodes_list
tools.description: List all configured cluster nodes with their host and port.

node.description: Name of the cluster node to check.

tools.name: remote_execute
tools.description: Execute an MCP tool on a remote cluster node. Only allows existing MCP tools — no arbitrary commands.

node.description: Name of the remote cluster node (e.g. 'streaming-pc').

tool.description: Name of the MCP tool to execute on the remote node.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the remote tool.

tools.name: setup_dual_pc_teleport
tools.description: Orchestrate full dual-PC Teleport setup: verify OBS on both nodes, configure host output on sender, add teleport-source on receiver, validate connection.

host_node.description: Cluster node name for the Teleport host (sender). Defaults to 'gaming-pc'.

client_node.description: Cluster node name for the Teleport client (receiver). Defaults to 'streaming-pc'.

scene_name.description: Scene name on the client for the Teleport source. Defaults to 'Teleport Feed'.

quality.description: JPEG quality for Teleport stream. Defaults to 90.
